name: @innytypes/app
description: The new InnyTypes application: the shell, the runtime and the services process (plan 0018).

scripts.build: npm run build:processes && npm run build:pages && npm run build:editor && npm run build:packages
scripts.build:processes: esbuild src/shell/main.ts src/shell/preload.ts src/shell/view-preload.ts src/runtime/main.ts src/runtime/event-source.ts src/services/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:electron --external:node-red --external:express --external:@node-red/nodes --outbase=src --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.cjs --log-level=warning
scripts.build:pages: esbuild src/ui/pages/app.ts src/ui/pages/app.css src/ui/pages/index.html src/ui/view/view.ts src/ui/view/view.html --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome140 --format=iife --loader:.html=copy --outbase=src --outdir=dist --log-level=warning
